reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and I want a known dose from a named lab with the batch report I can actually open. Bisglycinate with no oxide at $24.99 is worth one box to try.
objection: A foil sachet every day is a lot of packaging waste for 2 capsules, and I would check that the lab report really matches my batch number before I order a second box.
would_change_my_mind: If the named lab report was missing or did not match the batch number, I would not buy.
